discovery_notes: Loungefly 2021 cell. All claims from search snippets (30 searches). Core: Loungefly.com weekly LE 1,000 $25 Tuesday drops (DPB monthly calendars + per-pin posts, MickeyBlog Aug preview). Iron Man Funko Pop LE key reused from 225_b096 as corroboration only. Mystery sets: only chases and per-sign designs recorded; other named characters held. Most packs held (character lists only); Zootopia 4pc recorded per pin. BoxLunch items without explicit maker keyed boxlunch-*. Calendar-only LE entries recorded with minimal claims.
